source_title: Anyone Here Use Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy?
snippet_primary: "I'm currently using Gumroad to sell my plunges and sample packs. It's been an overall good experience and I've built a solid business on it over the last 2 years. However, recently they've made several changes that I really don't like so I'm looking to switch."
subject_exact: Single seller reported 2-year Gumroad use for sample packs with dissatisfaction due to recent platform changes
